selector_contract.rule: The future harness MUST expose this normalized semantic view. n18_entry is assertion-view trace state derived from the catalog and E013/E026, not an added M1-04 control_decision. Selectors do not authorize adding envelope fields or scientific payloads.

global_assertions.description: Scenario catalog strictly validates against its declared Draft 2020-12 schema.
Fixture manifest strictly validates against its declared Draft 2020-12 schema.
M1-06 asset registry validates against its declared schema.
Every materialized request and run envelope validates against M1-04.
Scenario, fixture case and acceptance case are a 21-item ordered bijection.
All frozen inventory counts equal their recomputed source counts.
Every submission resolves one declared request variant and no unused variant exists.
All and only 326 non-null attempt fixture keys resolve under the frozen current-phase root; null keys resolve nothing.
Runtime semantics are an exact projection of the selected scenario, not a recomputation.
Every run remains unmistakably Mock and non-production.
All Gate, recalc, condition and join routing sources are scenario literals only.
Fixtures and outputs carry only transport/state stubs and never scientific scores, candidates, thresholds or computed conclusions.
Artifact, error, attempt and audit references are closed and unique.
Canonical IDs use only M1-06 namespaces; Dify system IDs cannot replace them.
Both workflows call exactly the registered current-phase provider and 26 tool identities.
Main and debug differ only in permitted observability fields, never in business semantics.
No frozen legacy identity or path enters current-phase assets or results.
M4 can freeze v0.1 only after every case and submission executes with zero blocker failures.
